title: Hand-curated publication list
description: Source of truth for the CV and site publication lists. INSPIRE never generates or expands this file — see CLAUDE.md. There is deliberately no `contribution` and no `role` field.

date.description: arXiv / first-public date as YYYY-MM. NOT the journal publication date — see the header comment in publications.yml. Sorts the rendered output; never displayed.

authors.description: 'CMS Collaboration', or first author in 'M. Atif et al.' form.

ref.description: Human-readable citation: 'Phys. Rev. D 110 (2024) 012004', or 'arXiv:2502.00181' while unpublished.

arxiv.description: Bare arXiv id, quoted so 2402.18658 is not read as a float. Old-style ids (hep-ex/0123456) also allowed.

doi.description: BARE DOI — no https://doi.org/ prefix. The prefix is presentation, added by the renderer; inspire.py queries /api/doi/{doi} with this value.

inspire.description: INSPIRE control_number (recid). Optional; `inspire.py check --fix` backfills it.

domain.description: Exactly two values, matching the CV's section split. Instrumentation work is domain: physics carrying an `instrumentation` tag — NOT a third domain.

tags.description: Closed vocabulary. Variants are filters over these, never copies of content. Adding a value means editing both schemas — that friction is deliberate.

allOf.description: An entry must be findable by machine: at least one of arxiv, doi or inspire must be present, or `check` can never verify it.
